horoscope: There may be times this week when creative, leisure, or romantic goals interfere with your efforts to get back on track, dear Aries, as Jupiter and Saturn form a minor clashing aspect. Try to look within rather than to others for happiness. Fortunately, a forgiving, comfortable energy supports speaking with less guardedness today. You might decide to talk through a problem or dilemma, and helping someone may end up helping you. You’re seeking ways to heal and improve. There is great energy with you for charitable, supportive relationships. In fact, you take pleasure in putting your faith in others or giving someone the benefit of the doubt.

With a Jupiter-Saturn transit strong this week, dear Taurus, unsettled matters, a lack of closure, or fears you’re wrestling with can temporarily undermine your sense of comfort. Still, the friction you experience now can motivate you to make meaningful improvements. However, as the day progresses, it’s a strong time to rise above tension. You can gain an edge in your work, move into a stronger position, or develop a stronger plan to achieve your goals. Being generous and charitable with others and offering your services freely can be a key to this. Today's Moon stirs up your curiosity, and it's a good time to put out your feelers and pick up interesting tidbits.

With a Jupiter-Saturn transit strong this week, dear Gemini, you may feel some tension or face some dilemmas. Your social goals or responsibilities to your friendships may clash with your strong desire to pursue your personal interests, plus your general busyness and increased involvement in daily affairs. It can be difficult to handle it all, and the need for some moderation may become quite apparent. Fortunately, you can find some satisfaction in helping others with information or advice. As well, as the day advances, there is a gentle ease or flow between you and friends, co-workers, and associates. Tolerance, charity, and generosity are themes.

With a Jupiter-Saturn transit, dear Cancer, pursuing your money, comfort, and security goals can sometimes clash with your responsibilities to the outside world. You may benefit from a slowdown. Criticism can be annoying, but it may contain a small kernel of helpful truth you can use to your advantage. Aim to handle your responsibilities to help free yourself up for more lighthearted fare. Fortunately, it’s a good time to develop your talents, work on a money-making venture, or put effort into finding something lost or hidden. Business, career, and reputation get a boost today and tomorrow, and the key is to extend your help, services, advice, or expertise to someone in need.

Jupiter forms a minor challenging aspect with Saturn today, dear Leo, and some disillusionment is possible. However, it's something that opens your eyes to a new beginning or that puts you on the road to improvement. Certainly, disruptions in your personal or private life can distract your efforts to buckle down this week. Fortunately, it’s a generally auspicious time to form permanent alliances that positively influence your life. As well, you can be in a strong position to team up with or otherwise cooperate with others to get things done. Giving a partner or friend the benefit of the doubt or a pass for something you might normally let slide can be in focus and can enhance your bond and make you feel quite proud of yourself, to boot. While there may be some differences in your visions of where you’re heading or your long-term goals, there can be great understanding and tolerance now, and this carries you forward.

With a Jupiter-Saturn minor challenge this week, dear Virgo, you may be dealing with some disillusionment in spots. Your increased attention to downtime, private matters, or your emotional health isn't always meshing smoothly with equally powerful nudges to specialize or get serious about your inner world or intimate life. Ideally, from the friction occurring now, you find the motivation to make changes and improvements. Fortunately, as the day advances, a pleasing air of acceptance and understanding emerges, and you may thoroughly enjoy providing a service or devoting time to helping others.

With Jupiter and Saturn forming a minor challenging aspect this week, dear Libra, your expanded social life or friendships, connection with your community, or your pursuit of happiness goals can clash with a partnership. For example, a partner could be annoyed with the attention you’re giving these things. Instead, your relationship goals and social goals seem to be at cross-purposes right now. You could experience some fear of disapproval or lack of support. As today advances, it comes naturally to lighten up. Connecting with others and making a concerted effort to understand where they are coming from can be satisfying now. You feel good about yourself when you put your faith in people you care about.

There can certainly be times when your enjoyment of pursuing your more ambitious goals can conflict with your need to structure your daily affairs, dear Scorpio. This theme can be more prominent this week as Jupiter and Saturn form a minor challenging aspect. While you’re likely to do battle with different goals and conditions, a comfortable balance is within reach. Duties and responsibilities tend to keep you busy, but there are always workarounds if you look for them. Fortunately, it's relatively easy to rise above problems today, and you might enjoy helping someone out or simply expressing your faith in them. Work might benefit from offering something freely and, in the process, gaining the trust of others.

With a Jupiter-Saturn transit strong this week, dear Sagittarius, circumstances may challenge your need to simplify and structure your life. Attention to your studies, travels, or adventures can seem to clash with this mission. A minor setback, obstacle, or stubbornness can pause your plans. However, with some slight adjustments, you’ll rather quickly be back on track. Fortunately, today, you’re in an excellent position to convey what you mean and communicate with impact. It’s a great time to express your faith in someone, offer help, especially through advice or information, and find new things to love about someone.

You have a greater need to organize and structure your home life these days, dear Capricorn, but this doesn’t always mesh well with your intimate world or special projects. Striking a balance is the challenge now. Be especially mindful to keep things in moderation. Family members or home responsibilities can feel burdensome or restrictive at times, especially compared with your relationships or passion projects. Your instincts may signal that you need to slow down and adjust. Fortunately, the motivation to improve and advance is with you today, and this fuels you. Good energy is with you for forgiveness or acceptance in relationships, particularly with family. It’s easier to overlook minor problems and see the value of your connections overall.

With a Jupiter-Saturn transit in play this week, dear Aquarius, you may find it smart to be a little more mindful of what you say or release. Paying more attention to health, fitness, and routines can sometimes clash with personal interests. It’s important to tone things down if you have too much on your plate. You may need to redo or retry rather than move plans forward. Pace yourself and try not to let delays or restrictions weigh you down, but if they do slow you down, this might ultimately help you get back on track. Fortunately, there's generosity in your manner that endears others to you today. You are willing to put in extra effort or express your dedication to your relationships.

With a Jupiter-Saturn transit strong this week, dear Pisces, you can sometimes feel weighed down, or you could face some realities that ground you. Your pursuit of better working conditions and wellness routines may temporarily clash with your financial goals. Instead, you may be feeling the pinch if you've invested too much in these endeavors. The need to rein things in just a little may be apparent. Fortunately, you can be particularly generous with others, and they with you, which softens the mood. It’s a good time for concentration and dedication, which is a magical combination.
